high_level_description: The image depicts a wall-mounted lamp with a unique, origami-inspired design. The lampshade is composed of multiple triangular panels that are folded and arranged to create a petal-like structure, resembling a flower. The color of the lampshade is a light beige or cream, which contrasts softly against the plain white wall it is mounted on. The lamp has a brass-colored bulb holder at its center, which adds a touch of elegance and warmth to the overall design. The lamp is securely attached to the wall using screws at the corners of the lampshade.
